note: FALLBACK linear calibration for the LP PT board (board 21 = JSON slot1, ch 1..10). ADC 0 -> 0 PSI, ADC full scale (2^31) -> 1000 PSI, straight line, no offset. NOT a per-sensor calibration. HP board 22 is deliberately absent: its 4-20 mA channels are converted from [boards.pt_board_2] by convert_hp_pt_to_pressure(). NOTE: arrays MUST stay on one line - the C++ regex loader rejects pretty-printed arrays.
